messages:
marta: @auditor_john saw your request about proof for the RBAC change. We pulled a preliminary set of artifacts but need to confirm the exact scope and format you want (signed manifest vs raw logs vs decrypted payloads).

auditor_john: Hi Marta — scope: evidence to satisfy ISO A.9 and SOC2 control equivalence. We need chain-of-custody linking the RBAC change ticket -> deployed config/binary -> KMS keyproof. Preferred deliverables: signed manifest (sha256 entries), CloudTrail KMS Encrypt/Decrypt events, KMS key alias->key-id mapping, and pre/post kubernetes rolebinding snapshots. Sampling: 3-5 changes from a 30-day window around the primary change. We do NOT require decrypted secret contents, only proofs that decrypt occurred and which principal invoked it.

laura: Got it. Which ticket is the root? I'll pull the k8s audit logs and CI job IDs. Quick Q: do you want the full CloudTrail JSONs or redacted copies (we can redact PII but will mark redactions in the manifest)?

auditor_john: Full CloudTrail JSONs are preferred. If you redact, include an entry in the manifest that states which fields were redacted and why. Also include S3 object metadata (ETag) and the timestamp ranges covered.

pranav: For KMS chainproof we can produce: 1) CloudTrail KMS event records (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey), 2) key rotation history for the key(s), 3) alias->key-id mapping, 4) attestation/ekm certs if EKM used, 5) signed artifact manifest.json. Example manifest entry (conceptual): {path: "evidence/rb/rolebinding-2026-03-01.json", sha256: "<hex>", s3_etag: "<etag>", signed_by: "evidence-bot", commit_sha: "<sha>", ci_job_id: "<id>", deploy_id: "<id>"}. We'll sign manifest with the evidence service key.

marta: Here's the two-line snippet I'm planning to run to create the manifest and signature locally:```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/rolebinding-2026-03-01.json ./ && sha256sum rolebinding-2026-03-01.json >> manifest.sha256
gpg --armor --detach-sign -u evidence@redwood.com manifest.sha256
```

evidence-bot: :white_check_mark: evidence-bot created package and presigned link (expires in 7d): https://s3.redwood.example/evidence/1776004321-package.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800

laura: Uploaded package named evidence-1776004321-package.tar.gz to s3://redwood-evidence/packaged/; it contains manifest.json, manifest.sha256, rolebinding snapshots, and a cloudtrail export at s3://redwood-evidence/cloudtrail/ct-1776004321.json.gz

auditor_john: Thanks — a few clarifications before we close the loop: (1) in manifest.json please include commit SHA + CI job id + deploy id for each artifact so we can map change -> artifact; (2) for RBAC snapshots include `kubectl get rolebindings -o yaml` outputs and the apiserver auditID that shows the actor who changed it; (3) for vuln triage: if any CVEs are referenced in the ticket include CVE IDs, fix PRs, dates, and status; (4) for KMS logs: include alias->key-id mapping and rotation timestamps.

pranav: Noted. One implementation caveat: CloudTrail sometimes logs the KMS alias rather than full key-id in cross-account setups. We'll include a signed key_metadata.json that maps alias -> key-id and includes rotation history and whether EKM/HSM attestation was used.

marta: tagging @laura @pranav — we'll produce the final package and a short control-mapping doc (map artifact -> ISO/SOC control) by EOD tomorrow. If you need direct S3 access instead of presigned links we can create a time-limited role for reviewers.

auditor_john: That sounds good. Please ping me when the package is ready and let's schedule a 30-min walkthrough to validate mapping. :thumbsup:
